name: suman-mart
description: Suman Mart / ShopNest — e-commerce + dropshipping platform. Monorepo: apps/storefront (customer Next.js app), apps/admin (admin Next.js app), apps/api (Cloudflare Workers API), packages/* (shared contracts).

scripts.dev: cd apps/storefront && exec bun next dev -p 3000 2>&1 | tee ../../dev.log
scripts.dev:admin: cd apps/admin && exec bun next dev -p 3001 2>&1 | tee ../../admin-dev.log
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/storefront build && bun run --cwd apps/admin build
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/storefront lint && bun run --cwd apps/admin lint
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/storefront test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/storefront typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/admin typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck
